recommendations.meaning_comparison: The test uses a simply supported specimen and a central point load to infer elastic stiffness from deflection. Plastic bending concerns irreversible bending response; springback concerns recovery after unloading a forming process. The test configuration is a distinct application, also distinct from Young’s modulus or the neutral-axis concept alone.
authoring_conditions: Use the ideal elastic, small-deflection beam-model conditions for the displayed stiffness relation.

recommendations.meaning_comparison: A graph Laplacian is a standard discrete Laplace operator on a graph. A different label or a degree-minus-adjacency formula does not by itself establish an identity beyond the registered operator. This is outside the recommended 200.

General topological homeomorphism is a continuous bijection with a continuous inverse. The registered graph-theoretic relation is graph equivalence by subdivisions; this does not absorb the general mapping concept.

Euler’s polyhedron formula is the sphere-like polyhedral case V−E+F=2 of the broader Euler-characteristic invariant, not the complex-exponential Euler formula. The significant nearest baseline is Q852973 as well as the homonymous Q184871.
evidence: selection.proposed.json proposals 52 and 77; baseline-index concepts/Q852973 and Q184871
authoring_conditions: Keep the sphere-like/genus-zero condition and explain the special-case relation to Euler characteristic; do not present another unrestricted Euler-characteristic identity.

recommendations.meaning_comparison: Waiting-time memorylessness is invariance of the residual-wait distribution after elapsed waiting; the Markov property conditions future evolution on current state. These are related but different claims and the new distributional scope is explicit.
Conditioning preserves specified information and produces an information-dependent random variable; an unconditional expected value averages over that uncertainty.

The critical point is the endpoint of the liquid-vapor coexistence curve. A supercritical fluid is the region/state beyond the critical temperature and pressure. Boundary and region are separate supported learning subjects.
Barrier transmission includes non-ionization situations. Tunnel ionization is one narrower application, so general quantum tunneling is not a new name for the already registered ionization effect.
Crack growth equation is a class. The Paris law is one empirical power law, with a middle fatigue-growth validity regime and fitted constants, rather than the class under a new label.

Concentric core/fan outlets concern the arrangement of two streams; converging-diverging area progression concerns acceleration along a stream. They can coexist and are not interchangeable geometries.
Adjustable geometry and its operating-range/weight tradeoff are separate from the fixed nozzle’s sonic throat and expansion mechanism.
